o1: Enables guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity and small GTPase binding activity. Involved in generation of neurons; modulation of chemical synaptic transmission; and regulation of neuron projection development. Acts upstream of or within embryonic body morphogenesis. Is located in axon; cytoplasm; and muscle cell projection. Is expressed in egg-laying apparatus; hermaphrodite gonad; male sex myoblast; nervous system; and tail hypodermis. Predicted to be part of a parallel elongation pathway. Used to study epilepsy. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder; autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 44; cerebral atherosclerosis; cerebral infarction; and coronary artery disease. Orthologous to human KALRN (kalirin RhoGEF kinase) and TRIO (trio Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor).
